howto.title: Make Your Pet Dance in 3 Steps

items.title: Upload a Pet Photo
items.description: Choose a clear photo of your pet. Front-facing photos where your pet is looking at the camera work best. Both close-ups and full-body shots produce great results.

items.title: Pick a Dance Style
items.description: Choose from fun, energetic dances or gentle sways. Our Pet Dance templates are specifically designed to look natural and adorable with animal subjects.

items.title: Generate & Share
items.description: Get your pet dance video in about 30 seconds. Download and share on social media, send to friends, or save for your personal collection of adorable content.

items.question: What types of pets work best?
items.answer: Dogs and cats produce the best results since the AI is optimized for recognizable faces. However, any pet photo with a clear, visible face can work — rabbits, hamsters, birds, and more.

items.question: Does my pet need to be looking at the camera?
items.answer: Front-facing photos where your pet is looking toward the camera produce the most natural-looking dance videos. Side profiles can work but may have less realistic results.

items.question: Which dance style is best for pets?
items.answer: The Pet Dance and Fun templates are specifically designed to look natural with animal subjects. Gentle Sway is also popular for creating cute, calming pet content.

items.question: Can I use multiple pet photos?
items.answer: Each generation uses one photo. To create videos of multiple pets, generate them individually and combine using a video editor, or use a photo where both pets are visible.

items.question: Are pet dance videos safe to share?
items.answer: Absolutely! Pet dance videos are family-friendly content that's perfect for sharing on any platform. They're one of the safest types of viral content you can create.
